visual.general_description: Low-power pink-purple tissue section with a large rounded pale nodule under a thin surface layer.
visual.detailed_description: Whole-mount style stained section with no printed text, scale bar or labels. A large dome-shaped nodule with a fairly uniform pale pink granular texture occupies the upper and central part of the frame and is bounded by a thin darker pink band. A thin surface epithelial layer runs over the dome, and two thin dark cracks cross the nodule. Below and at both sides the tissue is more heterogeneous and pink-purple, and at the right the surface edge is wavy with rounded nests along it.
